prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Houston, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1385; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Houston, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had the green light and was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic when the impact came. Since the collision, I have felt stiffness and soreness in my neck and lower back, and I have been seeing a doctor for treatment of a neck and back strain. I have described the events the same way each time I have spoken with the adjuster, the police officer at the scene, and my medical provider. I am the named driver on this policy and was operating my own vehicle at the time. I am submitting this statement so that my claim can be reviewed, and I am happy to provide any further information or documentation that would help.
